map.对数 logₐx 是满足 aʸ=x 的指数 y；定义域 x>0、a>0 且 a≠: The logarithm logₐx is the exponent y satisfying aʸ=x, with domain x>0, a>0 and a≠1. This page outputs log₁₀x, ln x, log₂x and a custom-base result side by side, with the custom base computed via the change-of-base formula ln x / ln a.
map.若 aʸ=x（a>0、a≠1、x>0），则 y=logₐx，即对数是指数运算的逆: If aʸ=x (a>0, a≠1, x>0) then y=logₐx, i.e. a logarithm is the inverse of exponentiation. Common properties: logₐ(x·y)=logₐx+logₐy, logₐ(x/y)=logₐx−logₐy, logₐ(xⁿ)=n·logₐx, logₐx=ln x / ln a (change of base). This page always outputs the three common bases log₁₀, ln and log₂ and also allows a custom base; a base <=0 or =1 is reported as invalid.
map.真数必须大于 0：输入 0 或负数时页面提示「真数 x 必须 > 0（对数定义域: The argument must be greater than 0: entering 0 or a negative number prompts "the argument x must be > 0 (logarithm domain)". The base must be greater than 0 and not equal to 1; with base 1 no argument maps to a unique exponent. Do not mix up log and ln: engineering and chemistry use log₁₀ for pH, decibels and magnitudes, while probability and continuous growth use ln. Pitfall 1: writing logₐ(x+y) as logₐx+logₐy - addition has no such property; only a product splits into a sum. Pitfall 2: confusing logₐ(xⁿ) with (logₐx)ⁿ; the former is n·logₐx, the latter exponentiates the whole logarithm. Values are shown to 3 decimals; for higher precision use the page's internal 12 decimals or recompute with the change-of-base formula.

map.为什么 ln(1,024) 是 6.931 而不是整数？: Why is ln(1,024) 6.931 rather than an integer?
map.因为 1,024 = 2^10，ln(1,024) = 10·ln2 = 10×: Because 1,024 = 2^10, so ln(1,024) = 10·ln2 = 10×0.693147 = 6.931; only base 2 gives the integer 10, which is exactly what the change-of-base formula explains.
map.底数为 10 时结果为什么常带小数？: Why are base-10 results usually fractional?
map.log₁₀ 只在 10 的整数次幂上取整（如 100→2、0.01→-2），其余: log₁₀ is an integer only for integer powers of 10 (e.g. 100→2, 0.01→-2); all other arguments give irrational values, shown to 3 decimals, and can be checked by raising 10 to the result.
